overview: This table sets the battle text, Cursed Energy gauge style, and lock-on cursor position for each character.
description: Per-character battle-UI presentation row linked from CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterUI: resource terminology, cursed-energy gauge preset, and lock-on cursor placement on the target.

ID.simple: The name that connects these settings to one character, so the game gives them to the right fighter.
ID.technical: The native UPROPERTY is Id (FName, row +0x8); the export names it ID and declares ImportKeyField=Id. AGameDataTableManager loads the single CharacterUIDataTable asset into CharacterUIDataTables (+0x470). Status_FindCharacterUIRow (retail 0x14ddf60, behavior-certified against retail) walks that array in order, rejects incompatible row structs, and returns the first matching non-null row; with bCheckNone=true it rejects NAME_None before lookup (used by the target cursor and VS-enemy interval callers). bUnknown is passed false at every call and is unread in the reconstructed finder. In the exports, 46 of 48 Character rows have non-None Id_CharacterUI values and map one-to-one onto these 46 keys; CP_081 and CN_210 use NAME_None and have no UI row. Missing rows are not handled uniformly: some consumers default, while others dereference the lookup result unchecked.

CharacterEnergyType.simple: Chooses whether battle labels call the resource Cursed Energy or Physical Strength for this character. Physical changes technique, boost, cost, and level report wording.
CharacterEnergyType.technical: EGameCharacterEnergyType is uint8 (None=0, Cursed=1, Physical=2, Invalid=255; the reflected enum dump agrees). Consumers test specifically for Physical: the button guide switches BTL_HUD_LABEL_0631/0632 (Cursed Energy Technique / Cursed Tool Technique), the damage combo switches 0710/0711 (Cursed Energy Increase / Physical Strength Boost), the command list and VS-enemy interval switch SYS_COMMON_LABEL_0049/0050 (Cursed Energy / Physical Strength), PvE growth switches labels 0202/0203 and 0204/0205, and customize chat switches level-report labels 0001/0002. The command list checks character CP_020 by ID before its Physical category branch and copies the raw enum into FGameCommandListActionCursedEnergyParameter::EnergyType and FGameCommandListActionCostParameter::EnergyType; downstream action widgets branch on Physical for cost labels. Export: 44 Cursed and 2 Physical (CP_060, CP_200); None and Invalid are unused. There is no universal missing-row fallback: the button guide, damage combo, VS-enemy interval and growth list default to Cursed behavior, but CommandList, CustomizeChat, GrowthDialog and GrowthLevelUp dereference the UI row without a null check.

CursedEnergyGaugeType.simple: Sets the look and colors of the Cursed Energy gauge in battle and battle menus. A few characters use their own special style.
CursedEnergyGaugeType.technical: EGameCursedEnergyGaugeType is uint8 (None=0, JujutsuSorcerers=1, CursedSpirits=2, Physical=3, CP_020=4, CP_110=5, Invalid=255; the reflected enum dump agrees). The value is a key into UGameWidgetCharacterParameter::CursedEnergyGaugeParameterMap through AGameWidgetManager::GetCursedEnergyGaugeParameter; its returned colors tint battle gauges, button-guide widgets, command-list gauges and VS-enemy interval icons. The button guide stores it with SetGaugeType and calls ApplyColors; battle character data passes it through SetupCursedEnergy to the gauge's SetGaugeColor. The C++ constructor only value-initializes the map and the getter falls back to a value-initialized default parameter for an absent key, so exact per-skin colors are not recoverable from reconstructed C++. Missing UI rows default to JujutsuSorcerers in the button guide, battle character data and VS-enemy interval; CommandList dereferences the row unchecked. Export: 22 JujutsuSorcerers, 20 CursedSpirits, 2 Physical, and one each CP_020 (row CP_020) and CP_110 (row CP_110); None and Invalid are unused.

TargetCursorHeightRate.simple: Where the lock-on cursor sits vertically on the character being targeted. Higher values move it closer to that character's top.
TargetCursorHeightRate.technical: float at row +0x14 (pinned by the retail layout check). UGameBattleTargetCursorWidget reads the target character's UI row, not the viewer's, then sets Translation.Y = (ScreenBounds.Bottom - ScreenBounds.Top) * (1 - HeightRate) + ScreenBounds.Top and Translation.X to the bounds center X; no clamp is applied. Thus 0.5 is the vertical midpoint and 0.6 lies 40% down from the top / 60% up from the bottom. The row constructor default is 0.0, but the sole consumer substitutes 0.5 when no row is found; it calls the finder with bCheckNone=true, so NAME_None also takes that default. Export: 44 rows at 0.5 and 2 rows at 0.6 (CN_040 and CN_240).

notes: One asset and one export exist: CharacterUIDataTable (/Game/DataTables/CharacterUIDataTable), mounted into DTM +0x470. There are no numbered shards or localization variants. The row struct has four reflected properties and passes the project's schema/type/wire-value/cpp verification.

All 46 UI keys are referenced one-to-one by non-None CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterUI values; CP_081 and CN_210 have NAME_None. The shared finder checks row-struct compatibility, rejects NAME_None only when bCheckNone=true, and returns the first matching table-array entry; with the single shipped asset, table order does not change exported behavior.

Constructor defaults are CharacterEnergyType=None, CursedEnergyGaugeType=None and TargetCursorHeightRate=0.0. Fallbacks are caller-specific, not universal: the button guide, damage combo, battle character data, VS-enemy interval and growth list use Cursed/JujutsuSorcerers/0.5 defaults, while CommandList, CustomizeChat, GrowthDialog and GrowthLevelUp dereference a missing row without a fallback. CP_020 and CP_110 are exclusive named gauge values used only by the rows with those IDs.

Gauge appearance is mediated by CursedEnergyGaugeParameterMap. Its entries are not present in reconstructed C++ and the getter returns a value-initialized default parameter for an absent key, so exact per-skin colors are not asserted. Behavior here comes from reconstructed C++ plus retail behavior/layout audits; no retail Blueprint graphs or in-game visual verification were examined, and no byte-identical match is claimed for the shared finder.

usages.detail: Registers and loads the sole CharacterUIDataTable asset into AGameDataTableManager::CharacterUIDataTables (DTM +0x470); the table name is also registered at line 349.
Defines Status_FindCharacterUIRow (retail 0x14ddf60): table-array walk, row-struct compatibility check, optional NAME_None rejection, and first-match return. Seven call sites use this shared finder.
Initialization and tick read the player's row for CursedEnergyGaugeType (guide colors) and CharacterEnergyType (BTL_HUD_LABEL_0631/0632); both fall back when the row is absent.
Inline table walk reads the player's CharacterEnergyType to choose BTL_HUD_LABEL_0710/0711; a missing row is treated as Cursed.
Inline lookup reads CursedEnergyGaugeType (default JujutsuSorcerers) and passes it through SetupCursedEnergy to the battle HUD gauge.
Indirect consumer: SetGaugeColor resolves the selected enum through the widget-manager parameter cache and applies main/sub/empty/exp colors to materials and tips.

BuildContents resolves the UI row through the row-type lookup, uses gauge type for colors, energy type for labels and attack category (CP_020 checked first), and copies the enum into action parameters; the UI row is dereferenced unchecked.
Indirect consumer: copied EnergyType selects cost-label text for cursed-energy, super and extra attacks.
Reads the target character's TargetCursorHeightRate with bCheckNone=true, defaults to 0.5 if absent, and applies the unclamped fraction to the target bounds for cursor Y.
Reads both energy and gauge types with shared-finder defaults (Cursed/JujutsuSorcerers) for the interval HUD label and gauge icons.
For level-report chat rows only, resolves the character through CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterUI and selects SYS_CUSTOMIZE_CHAT_LABEL_0001/0002; the UI row is unchecked.
Caches the current character's CharacterEnergyType (default Cursed) onto every PvE growth list item for its label pair.
Reads CharacterEnergyType for growth-dialog label pairs; the UI row itself is dereferenced without a null check.
Reads CharacterEnergyType for the level-up dialog's label pairs; the UI row itself is dereferenced without a null check.
Indirect cache: GetCursedEnergyGaugeParameter looks up the enum in CursedEnergyGaugeParameterMap and returns a value-initialized default parameter when absent; the manager wrapper forwards to it.
Defines the FName alias Id_CharacterUI used by every direct consumer to select this table's key; GamePhase_BattleDemo.cpp:111 also filters out character rows where that alias is NAME_None.
